entries.0917354fc84faeb1: It has a single segment, and its products are classified into five product groups: suction device-related, injector-related, electric pump-related, handwashing facility-related, and other. It handles essentially everything in-house, from basic research and product development through manufacturing.
entries.1296c465917e7f8e: Infusion pumps such as Kūdekku Eimī PCA
entries.2230cd0098c9752c: It was established in 1968 in Osaka City for the purpose of manufacturing and selling medical instruments. Its head office is in Izumi City, Osaka Prefecture, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 185. It has no parent company, subsidiaries or affiliates.
entries.2338f7ecf5ffbe92: An anesthesia-related product, this is a pressurized drug injector connected to catheters and other devices to continuously administer small amounts of local anesthetics and analgesics. Main products are the “Syringe Jector,” which uses atmospheric pressure; the “Balloon Jector,” which uses the contractile force of a balloon; PCA devices; and the “Eimī” infusion pump. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,317 million.
entries.24f6987e7cc63e80: An anesthesia-related product, this is a medical electrical device used to continuously administer extremely small amounts of drug solution under precise control. Main products are syringe pumps and infusion pumps, used in operating rooms, intensive care units and other settings. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥190 million.
entries.2637427d56a28788: Electric pumps such as syringe pumps and infusion pumps
entries.2c4e01c8acbbb407: Revenue is consideration from product sales
entries.2de4c11742aa7231: Medical devices related to anesthesia and infection prevention
entries.3bad8a86c0286b0a: It states that its strengths are product development closely tied to medical sites and original new product development that can provide new medical services based on sales activities, and that through these it will pursue securing its position as a top manufacturer that others cannot follow, and creating and developing new markets.
entries.40c799eafcf6908a: Under its corporate philosophy, 'We look at today's medicine and contribute to society through creating tomorrow's medicine,' it upholds a site-first principle of capturing latent needs at medical sites from the same perspective and commercializing them with original technology, and works to raise the share of existing products, develop micro pump-related products, and expand overseas sales.
entries.487c6df0f790e88f: As the market leader in the domestic market, it aims to establish the images of 'Daiken for Suction' (suction devices) and 'Daiken for Pumps' (injectors).
entries.56db33ca8dcac85a: It earns revenue from the consideration for its products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,290 million: suction device-related ¥6,529 million, injector-related ¥2,317 million, handwashing facility-related ¥651 million, other ¥602 million, and electric pump-related ¥190 million.
entries.57b67167966dce80: The track record of its core suction devices, whose sales volume has continued to rise more than 30 years after launch and which have maintained a high share at large acute-care hospitals, underpins its site-focused product development.
entries.5c910122f4d63661: Net income for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥922 million.
entries.61a91ef4a48a0aa0: Its revenue is centered on the domestic market, and as its overseas revenue ratio remains below 5%, its overseas expansion is at the stage of advancing certification acquisition and building sales structures.
entries.6c9831c330ea696e: Its products are delivered through medical device distributors to domestic medical institutions that have operating rooms, intensive care units, wards and other facilities. Information by major customer discloses that there is no customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue.
entries.86f3a30318c46df2: An anesthesia-related product, this is a medical electrical device used to continuously administer extremely small amounts of drug solution under precise control.
entries.8b70a93ad1f0468a: Products related to handwashing water devices used for hygienic handwashing by medical staff in operating rooms, intensive care units and hospital wards.
entries.97497114ee2554b4: With a system in which research and development through manufacturing and sales are handled consistently in-house, it has a structure that captures on-site needs, commercializes products and connects them through to sales.
entries.986728d510f22007: Products not classified in the above four product groups. Main products are the nonwoven Oifu drape “Buresuwōmu” with enhanced heat retention, bronchial blocker tubes, double-lumen bronchial tubes and disposable pulp systems. entries.a2347b6cba17785e: A product related to hospital infection prevention, this is a non-electric vacuum suction device that uses medical piping equipment as its suction source and aspirates body fluids and drainage such as blood, tissue fluid and saliva.
entries.a3d913e5e263b9da: Single-segment business that plans, develops, manufactures and sells medical devices for anesthesia and hospital infection prevention. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,290 million. Products are classified into five product groups: suction-related, injector-related, electric pump-related, handwashing facility-related and other. Research and development and production are conducted at the Product Development Research Institute and the Izumi Assembly Center, both in Izumi, Osaka Prefecture.
entries.a3d9cc91518bb17f: The management policy states that the company's revenue still depends heavily on the domestic market, its most recent overseas revenue ratio remains below 5%, and it is advancing measures toward obtaining MDR (European Medical Device Regulation) certification for sales in Europe.
entries.ae68429f193145b0: An anesthesia-related product, this is a pressurized drug injector connected to catheters and other devices to continuously administer small amounts of local anesthetics and analgesics.
entries.bdf6aef92a5c7d2d: Pressurized drug infusion devices such as Shirinjekutā and Barūnjekutā
entries.bfe425aed3ff47b0: A product related to hospital infection prevention, this is a non-electric vacuum suction device that uses medical piping equipment as its suction source and aspirates body fluids and drainage such as blood, tissue fluid and saliva. Main products are the sealed container with integrated coagulant “Fit Fix” and the “Q-in-Pot,” which uses disposable liners. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,529 million.

entries.d809f77f69b5d778: This is a business model in which it manufactures and sells medical devices such as suction devices, infusion devices and electric pumps, which are developed with original technology based on needs from medical sites that development staff gather directly, and earns revenue from product sales.
entries.da85c453cb667360: Vacuum suction devices such as Fittofikkusu and Kyūinpotto
entries.daab025c088a74cb: The business overview states that essentially all work from basic research and product development through manufacturing is performed by the company, and that production technology and quality control related to mass production are also managed and operated in accordance with the ISO standard (EN ISO 13485:2016).
entries.e346864f96dc2a1e: The analysis of operating results states that the suction device 'Fittofikkusu' has been on the market for more than 30 years since its launch in 1990, but its sales volume continues to trend upward along with the increase in the number of surgeries, and that it has maintained a high share at large acute-care hospitals with 300 or more beds.
entries.e394d48ae849e2ac: Products related to handwashing water devices used for hygienic handwashing by medical staff in operating rooms, intensive care units and hospital wards. Main products are the “Sterikīpu II” device, which supplies sterile or disinfected water, and the sterilized disposable towel “Waipeeru.” Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥651 million.
entries.ea529d5219284cb4: A research and development-oriented medical device manufacturer that handles anesthesia-related and hospital infection prevention-related medical devices in-house, from planning and development through manufacturing, and sells them to medical institutions in Japan.
